(a) General. The strength requirements must be met at each combination of airspeed and load factor on and within the boundaries of the representative maneuvering and gust envelopes (V-n diagrams) of paragraphs (b) and (c) of this section. These envelopes must also be used in determining the airplane structural operating limitations as specified in Sec. 25.1501.
(b) Maneuvering envelope.
(c) Gust envelope.
